events.title: 床下回声
events.description: 木板缝里传来轻轻的回声，像是房间下面还有房间。
events.descriptionEn: A soft echo comes from the floorboards, as if there are more rooms below.

choices.result: 纽扣落进口袋，手电光也亮了一点。
choices.resultEn: The button drops into your pocket and your flashlight seems brighter.

choices.result: 你在回声里找到更稳定的呼吸节奏。
choices.resultEn: You find a steadier breathing rhythm in the echo.

choices.textEn: Record the echo with a paper tube
choices.result: 纸筒里留下了一段会帮你找路的声音。
choices.resultEn: The paper tube keeps a sound that helps you find the way.

events.title: 塌下来的玩具通道
events.description: 散落的积木堵住侧路，缝隙后面有一只旧工具箱。
events.descriptionEn: Scattered blocks clog a side path. An old toolbox sits behind a narrow gap.

choices.text: 挤过去拿工具（-6 勇气）
choices.result: 木刺擦过手臂，但你找到了一只沉甸甸的枕头。
choices.resultEn: Splinters scrape your arm, but you find a heavy pillow.

choices.result: 你没有惊动楼梯深处的东西。
choices.resultEn: You avoid whatever waits deeper near the stairs.

choices.result: 你搭好了一套临时书本堡垒。
choices.resultEn: You build a temporary book fort.

events.title: 旧玩偶据点
events.description: 破旧小毯子还挂在椅脚上，工具架上仍有可用的东西。
events.descriptionEn: A torn blanket hangs from chair legs, and the tool rack still has usable gear.

choices.result: 你收好创可贴和备用电池，状态稳定了不少。
小牌挂在手电旁，提醒你别走得太急。
choices.resultEn: The tag hangs beside your flashlight, reminding you not to rush.

events.title: 倒过来的蜡笔地图
events.description: 一张潮湿的蜡笔地图把小屋画成了倒过来的迷宫。
events.descriptionEn: A damp crayon map draws the little house as an upside-down maze.

choices.result: 你学会了更准确地找到地板缝。
choices.resultEn: You learn how to find floor cracks more precisely.
You collect a pouch of buttons.

events.title: 卡住的木梯
events.description: 木梯卡在半空，旁边的电池盒里还剩一点电。
events.descriptionEn: A wooden ladder is stuck midair, with a little charge left in a battery box nearby.

choices.resultEn: You wire the battery into your flashlight.

choices.result: 绳结突然回弹，但你打开了发明箱。
choices.resultEn: The knot snaps back, but you open the invention box.

events.title: 汽水小泉
events.description: 浅浅的蓝色汽水从玩具石头下冒出，带着温热泡泡。
events.descriptionEn: A shallow blue soda spring bubbles from under toy stones.

choices.result: 你把泉水调成了可携带的药膏。
choices.resultEn: You mix the spring water into portable salve.
